    {"id":"Q01","requested_parts":["pod quantity","distribution and orientation","initial bag tokens"],"answer":"1. Four players use 3 randomly chosen Pods; lowest number in A, next in B, alternating A/B; all Locked side up. 2. Bag: 1 Blank, 4 Larvae, 1 Creeper, 1 Queen, 3 Adults plus 1 Adult per player (7 Adults total).","support":"supported","evidence":"Setup steps 7, 10"},
    {"id":"Q02","requested_parts":["filter objectives","deal","choice timing","rejected card","Egg trigger"],"answer":"1. Remove objectives marked for higher player counts; shuffle Corporate and Personal decks separately and deal each player one of each, hidden. 2. Choose one at First Encounter, when an Intruder first appears; remove other face down unseen. 3. Eggs are not Intruders and do not trigger this choice.","support":"supported","evidence":"Setup 16; First Encounter"},
    {"id":"Q03","requested_parts":["payment and discards","Contamination substitution","OR effects"],"answer":"1. Discard the used Action card plus exactly two additional Action cards, face up to own discard pile. With the stated hand, discard the used card and two others; one Action card remains. 2. Contamination cannot pay. 3. If the card has OR sections, choose one section.","support":"supported","evidence":"Actions: Action Cost; Actions from Action cards"},
    {"id":"Q04","requested_parts":["Fire timing","later action availability","discarding","later rounds"],"answer":"1. A Character ending their own round in a burning Room takes 1 Light Wound. 2. Passing ends their normal Actions for the Player Phase. 3. When passing, may discard any number of hand cards. 4. Fire wound occurs once after that Character's round; later players' rounds do not burn them again that turn.","support":"supported","evidence":"Turn Structure, Player Phase"},
    {"id":"Q05","requested_parts":["tile and counter","Exploration effect","Noise roll and token destination","Silence/Danger/occupied effects"],"answer":"1. Entering flips an unexplored tile and resolves its token; orient tile so token's item number faces Item Counter. 2. Resolve and remove token to box. 3. If empty, Noise roll; 1–4 places marker in numbered connected Corridor (including Technical Entrance if applicable); full Corridor triggers Encounter. 4. Silence gives no roll; Slime makes Silence Danger. Danger moves all eligible neighboring non-Combat Intruders in; if none, put Noise in each unmarked connected Corridor. Occupied destination means no Noise roll.","support":"supported","evidence":"Movement, Rooms and Corridors; Exploration tokens; Noise roll"},
    {"id":"Q06","requested_parts":["cost and replacement","forbidden conditions","Closed Door","Corridor stopping"],"answer":"1. Careful Movement costs 2 Action cards and replaces the post-move Noise roll with placing Noise in a chosen Corridor connected to destination. 2. Forbidden in Combat and if all destination connected Corridors already contain Noise; follows normal movement rules. 3. Closed Door blocks crossing. 4. No one can stop in a Corridor.","support":"supported","evidence":"Basic Actions: Careful Movement; Movement, Rooms, and Corridors"},
    {"id":"Q07","requested_parts":["Encounter sequence","Noise removal","token destination","Surprise comparison","Contamination count"],"answer":"1. Attempted Noise placement on an already marked Corridor triggers Encounter: discard all Noise in Corridors connected to Room (including Tech entrance), draw token, place matching mini if nonblank. 2. Drawn token is set aside outside bag; it returns only by applicable rule (e.g. Tech Corridors). 3. Compare token number to triggering player's Action AND Contamination hand cards: fewer cards than number means Surprise Attack. 4. Contamination cards count.","support":"supported","evidence":"Encounters; Technical Corridors; Noise roll"},
    {"id":"Q08","requested_parts":["multiple eligible Intruders","no eligible Intruders","movement Encounter status","Slime/Silence"],"answer":"1. Danger moves ALL eligible neighboring Intruders not in Combat. 2. If none, place Noise in every connected unmarked Corridor (Tech if entrance). 3. Intruder movement into Character Room is not an Encounter, though it creates Combat. 4. Character Slime turns Silence into Danger.","support":"supported","evidence":"Exploration tokens; Encounters; Slime marker"},
    {"id":"Q09","requested_parts":["Encounter Blank outcome","Noise and Blank disposition","Adult addition","bag-development Blank contrast"],"answer":"1. Encounter Blank places Noise in every connected Corridor; no mini appears. 2. Return Blank to bag. 3. If it was last token in bag, add an Adult if available, otherwise none. 4. Bag development Blank adds an Adult if available, then returns Blank; no Encounter Noise procedure is stated.","support":"supported","evidence":"Blank token in an Encounter; Intruder bag development"},
    {"id":"Q10","requested_parts":["movement through same Closed Door","miniatures and Door result","later closing","Noise-triggered appearance"],"answer":"1. Intruders trying to move through a Closed Door destroy it simultaneously and stay in originating Room. 2. Door lies destroyed; movement can cross but it cannot be closed again (except Plasma Torch). 3. Noise-triggered appearance through a Closed Door is not blocked; Intruder appears regardless.","support":"supported","evidence":"Door tokens"},
    {"id":"Q11","requested_parts":["Tech Corridors miniature","injuries","token and Noise","Character/Door access"],"answer":"1. Intruder entering Tech Corridors disappears; remove miniature and all Injury markers. 2. Return its token to bag. 3. Noise marker there remains. 4. Characters normally cannot use Tech Corridors (Mechanic card and Technical Corridor Plans exceptions); Doors cannot be placed there.","support":"supported","evidence":"Technical Corridors"},
    {"id":"Q12","requested_parts":["Shoot cost/ammo and targeting","Melee cost/Contamination","target location","miss","two-hit result"],"answer":"1. Shoot costs 1 Action card and 1 Ammo; target Intruder in same Room using Weapon in Hand. 2. Melee costs 1 Action card, draws Contamination onto Action discard, targets Intruder in same Room. 3. Shoot miss has no Wound; Melee miss inflicts 1 Serious Wound. 4. Double hit is 2 Injuries by Shoot, 1 by Melee; Weapon modifiers may apply.","support":"supported","evidence":"Combat; Shoot; Melee Attack"},
    {"id":"Q13","requested_parts":["Larva death","Adult/Queen death check","Carcass timing","Queen Retreat"],"answer":"1. Larva dies at 1 Injury. 2. Adult: draw 1 Attack card, blood value ≤ total Injuries kills; Queen draws 2 and sums blood; ≤ total Injuries kills. Retreat arrow overrides numerical result. 3. Death of Adult/Queen removes mini and places Carcass in Room; Larva has no Carcass. 4. Either Queen card showing Retreat makes it flee via Event card Corridor instead of death check.","support":"supported","evidence":"Intruder Injuries and death; Intruder Retreat"},
    {"id":"Q14","requested_parts":["attacks before escape","target and order","death location","survival continuation"],"answer":"1. Before moving, resolve one Intruder Attack per Intruder in Room, larger first: Queen, Breeder, Adult, Larva. 2. Escape attack targets escaper. 3. If killed, Corpse remains in Room attempted to leave. 4. If survives, move to neighboring Room; explore if needed and Noise roll only if destination empty.","support":"supported","evidence":"Character Escape"},
    {"id":"Q15","requested_parts":["target and tie","hit determination","Larva exception","Contamination destination"],"answer":"1. Among Characters in Room, target with fewest Action cards; tie: First Player token/next in turn order. 2. Non-Larva draws Attack card; matching Intruder symbol hits and resolves effect, mismatch misses. 3. Larva draws no Attack card: remove mini and place on target board. 4. Target gains Contamination on top of Action discard; if already has Larva, attacking Larva disappears, old Larva stays, target still gains card and does not automatically die.","support":"supported","evidence":"Intruder Attack; Infest"},
    {"id":"Q16","requested_parts":["dressing at three Serious Wounds","third Light Wound","Heal","death drops"],"answer":"1. Dressing flips Serious Wound face down and suppresses effect only; it still counts, so further Wound at 3 Serious Wounds kills. 2. Third Light clears Light track and gives Serious Wound. 3. Heal removes a Light Wound or a Dressed Serious Wound as specified. 4. Death leaves Corpse Object in Room and drops Heavy Objects there; Item cards disappear from game.","support":"supported","evidence":"Character Wounds and death; FAQ Rules 24"},
    {"id":"Q17","requested_parts":["Canteen/Shower scan scope and removals","Larva result","Surgery scope/outcome/cost and turn"],"answer":"1. Canteen/Shower scan all Contamination cards in HAND; remove scanned non-Infected cards. Infected stays; if no Larva place one, if Larva already present die and place Creeper in Room. 2. Surgery scans cards in deck, hand, discard; removes all infected and removes Larva if present. 3. Then suffer 1 Light Wound, automatically pass, shuffle all cards including hand and remaining Contamination into Action deck; hand empty until next turn.","support":"supported","evidence":"Canteen/Shower scan; Surgery"},
    {"id":"Q18","requested_parts":["Shoot/Melee Egg destruction","Grenade/Molotov/Fire","Melee penalties","Noise timing","Nest destruction"],"answer":"1. Shoot or Melee in Room with uncarried Eggs; each Injury destroys one Egg. 2. Grenade destroys 2 Eggs, Molotov 1; Fire destroys 1 Egg per Fire Damage step (2 with Vulnerability to Fire). 3. Successful Egg Melee retains ordinary Contamination draw; missed Egg Melee causes neither Contamination nor Wound, but draw timing is unresolved. 4. After every attempt to destroy an Egg, roll Noise. 5. When no Eggs remain on Intruder board, Nest is destroyed; mark with 1 Injury.","support":"partial","evidence":"Eggs and the Nest; source limitations on missed Egg Melee"},
    {"id":"Q19","requested_parts":["entry conditions","prior resolution","capacity and Objects","waiting options/consequences"],"answer":"1. Pay 2 cards for Evacuation Room Action; Pod must be unlocked, free space, no Intruder or Malfunction in Section. Roll Noise first; an Intruder appearing/reaching Section makes attempt fail. 2. On boarding may launch immediately. 3. Each Pod holds 2 Characters; Heavy Objects use no Character space. 4. If wait, pass current turn; present in Section for bag-development Noise. At start of later Player Phase round choose remain/pass, launch, or exit free and take 2 Actions. Intruder in Section returns pod occupants to Room; Malfunction still allows waiting, launch, exit but prevents new entry.","support":"supported","evidence":"Escape Pods"},
    {"id":"Q20","requested_parts":["endgame check order","two Damaged Engines","non-Earth and exceptions","infected/Larva survivor check","Pod checks"],"answer":"1. Victory checks: Engines, Coordinates, Contamination, Objectives. 2. Two or three Damaged Engines explode ship; everyone/everything aboard dies, launched pod passengers already away. 3. Non-Earth kills hibernators; Quarantine Objective sleeper survives at Mars. 4. Every survivor including Pod passenger: no existing Larva => scan every Contamination card in deck/hand/discard; if any infected or Larva existed, shuffle all Action and Contamination cards across zones and draw top 4; any Contamination among four kills. Noninfected scans alone do not remove cards. 5. Pod passengers do require final contamination procedure.","support":"supported","evidence":"Victory Check"},
    {"id":"Q21","requested_parts":["tile/token placement","Coordinates/Destination/Time","Engines/Eggs/Weaknesses"],"answer":"1. Face-down shuffled Room 2 tiles on slots marked 2, then Room 1 tiles on 1 slots; place one face-down Exploration token on each; extras returned unseen. 2. Random Coordinates face down; Destination marker on B; Time on green space. 3. Each Engine has shuffled face-down Working/Damaged tokens stacked, top true. Intruder board starts 5 Eggs and 3 random Weakness cards face down.","support":"supported","evidence":"Setup steps 2–13"},
    {"id":"Q22","requested_parts":["Player Numbers","Character draft","starting contents/locations","Quest Item use"],"answer":"1. Random Help card numbered 1 through player count assigns Player Number/order; matching Inventory. 2. In number order draft: each draws/reveals 2 Character choices, keeps one, shuffles other back. 3. Character mini starts Hibernatorium; gets 10-card deck, Weapon loaded to capacity in Hand, and 2 Quest Items horizontal/inactive. Blue Corpse starts Hibernatorium. 4. Quest Items are not usable until mini-quest activates them.","support":"supported","evidence":"Setup steps 14–20"},
    {"id":"Q23","requested_parts":["refill timing","First Player pass","empty deck","discard destinations/visibility"],"answer":"1. At Player Phase start draw to 5 (6 if Cabins effect). 2. Then pass First Player token left, except first game turn. 3. If Action deck empty, shuffle discard into new deck when drawing. 4. Normal discards face up: used Actions/Contamination atop own Action discard; Items to matching Item discard; Events, Attack, Wounds to respective discard; markers to pool. Exceptions include Search rejected Item face down to bottom of deck. Inventory Items hidden; used Items shown.","support":"supported","evidence":"Turn Structure; Discard piles"},
    {"id":"Q24","requested_parts":["Event Phase order","moving Intruders","movement control/effect timing","deck exhaustion"],"answer":"1. Advance Time and Self-Destruct if active; Intruder attacks; Fire damage; Event card movement then effect; bag development. 2. Event-symbol Intruders not in Room with Characters move. 3. Corridor number on card directs; Technical Corridor movement returns token to bag/removes mini. Resolve event effect after movement. 4. Empty Event deck reshuffles discards; empty Intruder Attack deck reshuffles its discards when needed.","support":"supported","evidence":"Event Phase; Intruder Attack"},
    {"id":"Q25","requested_parts":["Larva/Creeper/Adult/Breeder development","Queen branches","token return/removal","Noise responsibility/next turn"],"answer":"1. Larva removed from bag, add Adult; Creeper removed, add Breeder. Adult returns to bag immediately before all players roll Noise in order, skipping Combat; encounter may draw that Adult. Breeder: players roll in order skipping Combat, then return token. 2. Queen in Nest with Character: place Queen and resolve Encounter; otherwise add Egg to board; return Queen token. 3. Blank adds Adult if available then returns Blank. 4. These rolls finish before next turn begins.","support":"supported","evidence":"Intruder bag development"},
    {"id":"Q26","requested_parts":["Fire/Malfunction exhaustion","existing target marker","marker return","hull loss consequences"],"answer":"1. If no marker available and instructed to place 9th Fire or Malfunction, ship ends/explodes. 2. A Room has max one of each; extra placement does nothing. 3. Removed markers return to pool. 4. Hull loss kills all Characters aboard including sleepers and all else aboard including Intruders.","support":"supported","evidence":"Fire markers; Malfunction markers; endgame"},
    {"id":"Q27","requested_parts":["disabled/enabled effects","placement restriction","Engine status","sleeper harm"],"answer":"1. Malfunction disables Room Action and Computer; Search remains usable (except special no-search Rooms). 2. Never place in Nest/Slime Room or unexplored Rooms. 3. Does not alter Engine token/status. 4. Hibernatorium Malfunction does not harm or wake already-hibernating Character.","support":"supported","evidence":"Malfunction markers"},
    {"id":"Q28","requested_parts":["hidden Items","visibility and inventory","use reveal","Heavy/added/added Items/Duct Tape"],"answer":"1. Normal Item cards in Inventory hidden; others see backs/colors. No size limit. 2. Any Item used must be shown. Heavy Items/Objects are public and occupy one of two Hand slots; found Weapons have 1 Ammo, never above capacity. 3. Add Items attach and act as one; Duct Tape combines two Heavy Items into one slot, not Objects.","support":"supported","evidence":"Items and Objects"},
    {"id":"Q29","requested_parts":["voluntarily dropped Item vs Object","timing/cost","found vs starting Weapon Ammo"],"answer":"1. Dropped Objects stay in Room; dropped Items are discarded/lost. 2. Drop any time on your turn, free, no Action. 3. Searched Weapon starts with 1 Ammo; Starting Weapon starts at printed capacity; neither can exceed capacity.","support":"supported","evidence":"Items and Objects; Drop"},
    {"id":"Q30","requested_parts":["deck choice","draw/keep/return","counter","zero/Special/Blue"],"answer":"1. Search deck matches Room color; white Room choose Red, Yellow, Green. 2. Draw 2, keep 1, return other face down to bottom. 3. Each Search lowers Item Counter by one; at zero ordinary Search impossible. 4. Scout Scavenging exception; Special Rooms cannot be searched; Blue Crafted Items not searchable. Nest and Slime Room prohibit any Search.","support":"supported","evidence":"Searching"},
    {"id":"Q31","requested_parts":["Craft Action cost/components","availability","deck inspection","crafted Items"],"answer":"1. Craft Basic Action costs 1 Action card plus two Item cards with matching blue Component icons. 2. Result must be available; otherwise cannot craft. 3. Craft deck may be looked through at any time. 4. Crafted: Antidote flame+medical cross; Taser battery/lightning+tool; Flamethrower flame+tool; Molotov flame+fabric.","support":"supported","evidence":"Crafting; Crafted Items"},
    {"id":"Q32","requested_parts":["Trade payer","participants","free exchange","Ammo","searched Heavy Item pickup"],"answer":"1. Only initiating Character pays one Action card. 2. All Characters in Room may mutually agree to trade, including non-initiators. 3. Gifts without exchange allowed; empty action without intended exchange disallowed, though honest negotiation may yield no trade. 4. Ammo cannot be exchanged. 5. Heavy Items from Search need no separate Pick Up Action; that Action is for Objects.","support":"supported","evidence":"Trade; FAQ Actions 1–2; Pick Up Heavy Object"},
    {"id":"Q33","requested_parts":["Weakness/Object correspondence","location","consumption","benefit","Objective research requirement"],"answer":"1. Corpse, Egg, or Carcass corresponds to Weakness card. 2. Object must be in Laboratory Room to Analyse. 3. Object is retained, not consumed. 4. Revealed Weakness stays face up and benefits all players. 5. Any player may research the corresponding Object before game end to satisfy Discover Weakness Objective; you need not do it personally.","support":"supported","evidence":"Laboratory; Objective types"},
    {"id":"Q34","requested_parts":["Room Action prerequisites/cost","Computer icon","Fire effects"],"answer":"1. Generally present in Room, pay 2 Action cards, not in Combat or Malfunctioning Room. 2. Computer icon has no independent effect; used by effects such as Motivation. 3. Fire does not generally prevent Room Action or Search; Character ending round there takes Light Wound.","support":"supported","evidence":"Room Actions; Fire markers; Motivation"},
    {"id":"Q35","requested_parts":["Armory target","amount","limits"],"answer":"1. Add ammo to one of your Energy Weapons. 2. Add 2 Ammo. 3. Cannot recharge Classic Weapons or exceed Weapon capacity.","support":"supported","evidence":"Room Actions: Armory"},
    {"id":"Q36","requested_parts":["three treatments","dress meaning","duplicate Serious Wounds"],"answer":"1. Choose one Emergency Room option: Dress all Serious Wounds; Heal one Dressed Serious Wound; or Heal all Light Wounds. 2. Dressing only suppresses Wound effect; card still counts toward 3 Serious Wounds. 3. Identical Serious Wound effects do not stack.","support":"supported","evidence":"Emergency Room; Character Wounds"},
    {"id":"Q37","requested_parts":["Signal effect","game purpose","Comms presence"],"answer":"1. Send Signal places a Status marker on your Character board's Signal space. 2. This is used only for Objectives. 3. Comms Room is always aboard in standard game.","support":"supported","evidence":"Comms Room; Objective types"},
    {"id":"Q38","requested_parts":["chosen Room with Fire","Intruders when Fire present","Room without Fire"],"answer":"1. Fire Control chooses any Room and discards its Fire marker if present. 2. All Intruders in chosen Room run away in random directions, drawing one Event card per Intruder. 3. Works even if no Fire, still scattering Intruders.","support":"supported","evidence":"Room Actions: Fire Control System"},
    {"id":"Q39","requested_parts":["start/stop/restart","advance/yellow/final","jump active","sleeping Character"],"answer":"1. Generator starts by placing marker on green first space; stop removes it; restart begins at green. 2. Advance one space each Time advance. First yellow makes sequence unstoppable and Pods unlock; may relock, and later yellow spaces do not unlock again. Final skull explodes ship. 3. Jump while active still counts ship destroyed. 4. Character cannot start while anyone hibernates; Coolant Leak Event can.","support":"supported","evidence":"Self-Destruct sequence"},
    {"id":"Q40","requested_parts":["target Room","Door condition","immediate procedure","cancellation/completion timing"],"answer":"1. Target any other Yellow Room. 2. Its connected Corridors must have no Destroyed Door. 3. Close all Doors around it and place Procedure token. 4. If all remain closed at end of current Player Phase, everything there dies and Fire removed; opening any Door first cancels procedure.","support":"supported","evidence":"Airlock Control"},
    {"id":"Q41","requested_parts":["timing/hand size","disable","paid action"],"answer":"1. At start of new turn, Character in Cabins with no Intruders draws one extra card, hand size 6. 2. Malfunction disables. 3. Passive effect, not a paid Room Action.","support":"supported","evidence":"Cabins"},
    {"id":"Q42","requested_parts":["distant Room selection","individual Door choices","Destroyed Door"],"answer":"1. Command Center can select any Room. 2. May choose which connected Corridor Doors to open or close individually. 3. Destroyed Doors cannot be closed again (except Plasma Torch); summary does not specifically state Command Center exception, so it cannot close a Destroyed Door.","support":"supported","evidence":"Command Center; Door tokens"},
    {"id":"Q43","requested_parts":["Engine Control check/change","Engine Room malfunction effect"],"answer":"1. Engine Control Room checks status of all three Engines but cannot change them. 2. Check works even if an Engine Room has Malfunction.","support":"supported","evidence":"Engine Control Room"},
    {"id":"Q44","requested_parts":["Hatch Control effect","Monitoring explored/unexplored scope","components/secrecy/replacement"],"answer":"1. Hatch Control flips one Pod Locked/Unlocked. 2. Monitoring Room secretly looks at any one unexplored Room tile and Exploration token; explored locations not specified as eligible. 3. Replace them after looking; may lie about what saw.","support":"supported","evidence":"Hatch Control System; Monitoring Room"},
    {"id":"Q45","requested_parts":["Slime acquisition Action","Item Counter/Malfunction","stacking","shower Fire"],"answer":"1. No Action needed: entering Room Covered With Slime automatically gives Slime. 2. No Item count; Malfunction cannot be placed there. 3. Slime max one; further does nothing. 4. Showering does not remove Fire.","support":"supported","evidence":"Room Covered With Slime; Shower Room; Slime marker"},
    {"id":"Q46","requested_parts":["Cockpit information/change","visibility","Destination meaning","post-hibernation/Intruder restrictions"],"answer":"1. Check Coordinates secretly views Coordinates card and may lie; Set Destination moves marker. 2. Secret check may be lied about. 3. Destination marker selects one of four entries on Coordinates card. 4. Cannot Set Destination with Intruder in Cockpit or once anyone hibernates.","support":"supported","evidence":"Cockpit"},
    {"id":"Q47","requested_parts":["checking vs repair/break","secrecy","announcement","prior check/functional Room"],"answer":"1. Check Engine secretly views top token; repair/break secretly views both and restacks in any order. 2. May keep whether repaired secret. 3. Must announce if order changed. 4. No prior check or functioning Engine Room required; works with Malfunction.","support":"supported","evidence":"Engines #1–#3"},
    {"id":"Q48","requested_parts":["legal time/conditions","roll/failure","success removal","later ship actions","Malfunction waking"],"answer":"1. Hibernate only on blue Time space, in Hibernatorium, no Intruder or Malfunction; pay 2 cards. 2. Roll Noise; Intruder appearance/reaching Room fails attempt. 3. Success removes mini and ends participation until end checks. 4. Once anyone hibernates, cannot change Destination or initiate Self-Destruct as Character. 5. Later Malfunction does not wake or harm sleeper.","support":"supported","evidence":"Hibernatorium; Self-Destruct"},
    {"id":"Q49","requested_parts":["Time end","last active Character end","active Self-Destruct","normal jump Intruders"],"answer":"1. Time final red: ship jumps immediately; non-hibernating aboard Characters die from g-force. 2. Last alive non-hibernating Character aboard dying/hibernating/launching ends game; advance active Self-Destruct to final, otherwise Time to final, resolve. 3. Intruders die if ship destroyed, not from normal jump. 4. Active Self-Destruct at hyperspace jump still means ship destroyed.","support":"supported","evidence":"End of the game"},
    {"id":"Q50","requested_parts":["direct attacks","indirect harm","examples"],"answer":"1. Characters cannot directly attack other Characters. 2. Indirect harm is possible. 3. Examples: lock someone in burning Room, activate Self-Destruct with crew aboard, or throw Grenade into Room with crew.","support":"supported","evidence":"Attacking other players"},
    {"id":"Q51","requested_parts":["Adult overflow procedure","unexplored movement"],"answer":"1. If all eight Adult models on board, Adults not in Combat retreat: remove them and return tokens to bag if possible, then place one in Encounter Room. If all eight are in Combat, summary explicitly leaves procedure unresolved. 2. Intruder moving into unexplored Room remains; do not reveal tile/token.","support":"partial","evidence":"Adult overflow; Intruders in unexplored Rooms"},
    {"id":"Q52","requested_parts":["small symbol Shoot restriction","larger symbol Shoot restriction","Melee ineligible symbol outcome"],"answer":"1. Small curled symbol hits Larva/Creeper only; miss other types. 2. Larger curved symbol hits Larva/Creeper/Adult; miss Breeder/Queen. 3. In Melee same restrictions; ineligible target is a miss and gives Character 1 Serious Wound.","support":"supported","evidence":"Combat die outcomes"},
    {"id":"Q53","requested_parts":["final scan with no Larva/no infected","four-card draw/removal","Pod Objective timing"],"answer":"1. No Larva: scan every Contamination card in Action deck, hand and discard. If none infected, no four-card draw. 2. Scanned non-Infected cards are not removed. 3. Launched Pod survivor still does final Contamination and Objective checks.","support":"supported","evidence":"Victory Check: Contamination; Escape Pods"},
    {"id":"Q54","requested_parts":["Antidote symbols","Taser symbols","Flamethrower symbols","Molotov symbols"],"answer":"1. Antidote: flame + medical cross. 2. Taser: battery/lightning + screwdriver/tool. 3. Flamethrower: flame + screwdriver/tool. 4. Molotov Cocktail: flame + folded cloth/fabric.","support":"supported","evidence":"Crafting"},
    {"id":"Q55","requested_parts":["Combat definition","marked action restrictions","unmarked actions","Eggs"],"answer":"1.
